title: Aurora Hunter: A Two-Stage Framework for Probabilistic Visibility Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2605.24038v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Aurora visibility at a given location requires two physically distinct conditions to hold at once: aurora occurring overhead, governed by solar wind-magnetosphere coupling, and observing conditions that permit detection, governed by cloud cover and moonlight. Approaches that conflate the two weaken the space-weather signal and limit cross-site generalizability. We develop Aurora Hunter, a two-stage cascade that separates occurrence prediction from observing-condition assessment. Stage 1 uses 43 physics-driven features to predict P(aurora identifiable in all-sky images) via gradient-boosted trees trained on joint Tromso+Kiruna data (about 16,600 hours, 2015-2023). Stage 2 models P(unobscured image class | identifiable) with logistic regression on 15 observing-condition features, trained on hours with identifiable aurora. The cascade P(visible) = P(identifiable) x P(unobscured | identifiable) achieves retrospective ROC-AUC of 0.9

translated_title: 极光猎手：一个用于概率可见性预测的两阶段框架
translated_abstract: 在给定地点观测到极光需要两个物理上截然不同的条件同时成立：其一是极光出现在头顶上空，这由太阳风-磁层耦合过程控制；其二是允许探测的观测条件，这由云量和月光决定。将两者混为一谈的方法会削弱空间天气信号，并限制模型在不同观测站点之间的泛化能力。我们开发了Aurora Hunter（极光猎手），这是一个两阶段级联框架，将极光发生预测与观测条件评估分离。第一阶段使用43个物理驱动特征，通过在特罗姆瑟与基律纳联合数据（约16,600小时，2015-2023年）上训练的梯度提升树来预测P（全天空图像中可识别极光）。第二阶段使用逻辑回归对15个观测条件特征建模P（图像无遮挡|极光可识别），并在极光可识别的小时数据上进行训练。该级联概率P(可见) = P(可识别) × P(无遮挡|可识别)实现了回顾性ROC-AUC达到0.9
tldr: 提出Aurora Hunter两阶段级联框架，将极光发生预测与观测条件评估解耦，通过级联概率模型实现极光可见性的概率预测，回顾性ROC-AUC达到0.9以上。
en_tdlr: Aurora Hunter is a two-stage cascade framework that decouples aurora occurrence prediction from observing-condition assessment, achieving probabilistic visibility forecasting with a retrospective ROC-AUC above 0.9.
